chip.description: 32-bit CISC processor (uPD70615/uPD70616) with 32 general registers, paged virtual memory and a four-level protection architecture; 24-bit address bus and 16-bit data bus. Main CPU of Sega System 32 and Multi 32.
chip.notes: src/devices/cpu/v60/v60.cpp in MAME 0.288, which quotes the NEC Semiconductor Selection Guide (Oct. 1995) for the uPD70615 feature list and address/data bus widths.
